verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a SaaS payments and merchant-of-record platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API and webhooks but never mentions an MCP server. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so there is no evidence of an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
